'''Dralla''' was a subscriber and commentator on "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]". Dralla was aware that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used [[GHT-series Medevac unit]]s on [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]]. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] countered the use of the droids by using false [[transponder]] signals to lure the units into the open to destroy them.
